categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in high-tech factory facility supply system engineering, including planning, design, and construction of gas secondary piping systems and integrated secondary distribution systems for semiconductor fabs. It also provides equipment services such as development, manufacturing, maintenance, and sales of process equipment components and related consumables. The business segments focus on semiconductor industry facility engineering and equipment services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company specializes in advanced gas secondary piping technology for semiconductor fabs, including ultra-high purity and safety piping systems. It develops proprietary equipment such as power-assisted carts, wireless remote controllers for automatic laser welding machines, and innovative valve lock structures with recyclable materials. The production methods emphasize precision engineering, safety, and integration of hardware and software to optimize process efficiency and reduce labor intensity.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are major domestic semiconductor manufacturers including wafer foundries and memory producers. The company also serves clients in optoelectronics, chemical industries, and semiconductor equipment suppliers. The primary market is the semiconductor industry, with expanding services to other high-tech manufacturing sectors requiring complex facility piping and equipment integration.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are primarily based in Taiwan with offices and warehouses in northern, central, and southern science parks. The company has established subsidiaries in Japan, Singapore, and Germany to support overseas expansion and provide localized services aligned with semiconductor industry global footprint. The geographic focus includes Taiwan, Japan, Southeast Asia, and Europe.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream segment of the semiconductor supply chain, providing facility engineering services and equipment integration essential for semiconductor manufacturing plants. It acts as a systems integrator and service provider between upstream raw material and equipment suppliers and downstream semiconductor fabs.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include deepening customer partnerships, expanding into new markets and industries, and developing innovative, sustainable products with ESG considerations such as energy saving, carbon reduction, and recyclable materials. R&D focuses on equipment automation, laser welding technologies, and cross-domain applications like smart agriculture and renewable energy. The company also emphasizes talent cultivation and operational efficiency improvements.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through project-based engineering services for facility supply systems and sales of equipment and components. The company also earns from equipment installation, maintenance, and after-sales services. It plans to diversify income by expanding product sales, equipment leasing, and certification services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes in a niche market with high entry barriers due to technical complexity and stringent quality and safety requirements. It positions itself as a leading supplier of gas secondary piping engineering services for semiconductor fabs, leveraging proprietary technologies and integrated service capabilities. Competitors include other specialized facility engineering firms and equipment service providers in the semiconductor industry.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported revenues of approximately NT$851 million, a 20.6% increase from the previous year, driven by growth in AI and HPC markets. Despite a slight decline in net profit due to increased expenses and one-time losses, the company maintains solid profitability with an EPS of NT$5.51. The company has expanded its asset base significantly, including property acquisitions, and continues to invest in R&D and overseas subsidiaries, indicating a growth trajectory aligned with semiconductor industry expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers highly specialized, safe, and reliable gas secondary piping systems critical for semiconductor manufacturing, with a strong emphasis on customization and integration. Its unique value lies in combining engineering services with proprietary equipment development, enabling enhanced operational efficiency, safety, and sustainability. The company’s commitment to ESG principles and continuous innovation differentiates it as a trusted long-term partner in a high-barrier, quality-sensitive industry.
